title: API Registry (api registry list/add/update/show/remove)
description: Implement the five api registry subcommands and the ApiRegistry domain class. The registry is a persistent local store of named API endpoint entries that agents can discover without re-documenting endpoints repeatedly across sessions. Each entry carries a full URL field consistent with api call --url.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-5 complete. ApiClient and api call working. IOutputWriter wired. No registry infrastructure exists yet.
goal: After 'zapi-cli api registry add --id cliq-channels --url https://cliq.zoho.com/api/v2/channels --method GET --purpose "List all Cliq channels"', the entry is persisted to registry.json and 'zapi-cli api registry list' returns it.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Api/ApiRegistryEntry.cs: sealed record with Id (required string), Url (required string — full endpoint URL), Method (required string), Purpose (required string). JSON keys: id, url, method, purpose via SnakeCaseLower.
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Api/ApiRegistryRoot.cs: sealed record with Apis (List<ApiRegistryEntry> = []).

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Api/IApiRegistry.cs: Task<ApiRegistryRoot> LoadAsync(ct); Task SaveAsync(ApiRegistryRoot root, ct); Task<ApiRegistryEntry?> FindByIdAsync(string id, ct); Task AddAsync(ApiRegistryEntry entry, ct) — add if new id, throw ZapiCliException(REGISTRY_ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS, exit 1) if id already exists; Task UpdateAsync(ApiRegistryEntry entry, ct) — overwrite existing entry by id, throw ZapiCliException(REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, exit 1) if id not found; Task RemoveAsync(string id, ct) — throw ZapiCliException(REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, exit 1) if id not found.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Api/ApiRegistry.cs implementing IApiRegistry: reads/writes registry.json at <configDir>/registry.json using System.Text.Json with SnakeCaseLower. Apply same 0600/ACL permissions as accounts.json on write.
ApiRegistryListSettings inherits GlobalSettings (no extra flags). ApiRegistryListCommand.ExecuteAsync: LoadAsync, WriteJson(root.Apis) — plain JSON array.

ApiRegistryAddSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--id")] required string Id, [CommandOption("--url")] required string Url, [CommandOption("--method")] required string Method, [CommandOption("--purpose")] required string Purpose. Validate(): reject if any required field is null/empty (INVALID_ARGS); reject if Method is not one of GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE (INVALID_ARGS); reject if Url host is not in ApiClient's host allowlist — reuse the same ValidateHost logic (HOST_NOT_ALLOWED). ApiRegistryAddCommand.ExecuteAsync: AddAsync (throws REGISTRY_ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS if id exists); WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { id } }).

ApiRegistryUpdateSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--id")] required string Id, [CommandOption("--url")] optional string? Url, [CommandOption("--method")] optional string? Method, [CommandOption("--purpose")] optional string? Purpose. At least one of --url/--method/--purpose must be provided (INVALID_ARGS). If --method is provided validate it is one of GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE (INVALID_ARGS). If --url is provided validate host allowlist (HOST_NOT_ALLOWED). ApiRegistryUpdateCommand.ExecuteAsync: FindByIdAsync — if null throw REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; build updated entry applying only the provided fields (keep existing values for omitted fields); UpdateAsync; WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { id } }).

ApiRegistryShowSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--id")] required string Id. ApiRegistryShowCommand.ExecuteAsync: FindByIdAsync; if null → ZapiCliException(REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, 1); WriteJson(entry).
ApiRegistryRemoveSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--id")] required string Id. ApiRegistryRemoveCommand.ExecuteAsync: RemoveAsync; WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { id } }).
Register IApiRegistry (ApiRegistry) as singleton in Program.cs DI. Register all five commands in Program.cs under 'api registry' branch.

Unit tests: registry add stores entry in registry.json; registry add with duplicate id → REGISTRY_ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS; registry add with non-Zoho URL → HOST_NOT_ALLOWED; registry list returns all entries; registry show returns single entry; registry show with nonexistent id → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; registry update changes only the supplied fields; registry update with nonexistent id → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; registry update with non-Zoho URL → HOST_NOT_ALLOWED; registry update with no fields provided → INVALID_ARGS; registry remove deletes entry; registry remove with nonexistent id → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
api registry add --id cliq-channels --url https://cliq.zoho.com/api/v2/channels --method GET --purpose '...' returns { "status": "ok", "data": { "id": "cliq-channels" } }
api registry add with same id again → REGISTRY_ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS on stderr, exit 1
api registry update --id cliq-channels --purpose 'Updated purpose' updates only the purpose field; url and method remain unchanged
api registry update --id nonexistent --purpose 'x' → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND on stderr, exit 1
api registry update --id cliq-channels (no fields) → INVALID_ARGS on stderr, exit 1
api registry add with --url https://evil.com/api → HOST_NOT_ALLOWED on stderr, exit 1
api registry add with missing --id → INVALID_ARGS on stderr, exit 1
api registry list returns a JSON array of all registered entries
api registry show --id cliq-channels returns the single entry as a JSON object
api registry show --id nonexistent → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND on stderr, exit 1
api registry remove --id cliq-channels removes the entry; subsequent list does not contain it
api registry remove --id nonexistent → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND on stderr, exit 1
registry.json written with 0600 permissions on macOS/Linux
contextForAgent: The api registry commands do NOT require an active account — they are purely local storage operations. The one security check that DOES apply is the host allowlist: 'api registry add' and 'api registry update' must validate any --url against the same allowlist used by ApiClient.ValidateHost. Extract ValidateHost into a shared static method (or internal class in ZapiCli.Core.Api) so it can be reused by ApiClient, ApiRegistryAddCommand, and ApiRegistryUpdateCommand. The registry.json file is stored at <configDir>/registry.json (same level as accounts.json, NOT in a subdirectory). Add REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND and REGISTRY_ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS to ErrorCodes both with exit 1. 'api registry add' errors if the id already exists. 'api registry update' accepts the same flags as add but all are optional (at least one must be supplied); it applies only the provided fields as a partial update over the existing entry and errors if the id does not exist. Registry entries have no secret fields, so no masking is needed in any output.

openItems.item: ValidateHost reuse between ApiClient and ApiRegistry
openItems.defaultAssumption: Extract ValidateHost into a static class ZapiCli.Core.Api.HostValidator with a single public static method ValidateHost(Uri uri). Both ApiClient and ApiRegistryAddCommand call this. This avoids code duplication and ensures both enforce the same allowlist.
Add REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND to ErrorCodes with exit 1. Message: "API registry entry '<id>' not found."
Add REGISTRY_ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS to ErrorCodes with exit 1. Message: "API registry entry '<id>' already exists. Use 'api registry update --id <id>' to modify it."
